contract.requirement: Sanity must construct the real View + Presenter
Sanity must boot the real app via create_app()
Sanity must fail on any problem-level diagnostic emitted during boot/construct/shutdown, on every channel the app owns (Python logging, Qt message handler, warnings, stderr)
Sanity must assert the app shuts down within a budget, not just call stop() in teardown
Integration must drive real input and wait on a terminal signal/state
